{{Quote|Oh, you have arrived in time to impede Shibb Nisshil's evil plan! His hunting team has captured a bull rancor in the wild and is taking it to an unspeakable fate. You must stop the hunting team and rescue the rancor!|Wallaw Loowobbli|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Wallaw Loowobbli''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Naturalist/Legends|naturalist]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he stayed at the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Trade Outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. While here, he tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with impeding the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Shibb Nisshil]]'s plan to capture [[Bull rancor/Legends|bull rancors]] and use them to create an an [[Army/Legends|army]] of Imperial [[Cybernetics/Legends|cyber]]-[[Rancor/Legends|rancors]]. Fearing devastation to the planet's ecosystem, the spacer agreed to help Loowobbli by [[Death/Legends|eliminating]] the hunting team and saving the rancor before it could be brought to Nisshil in the [[Science Outpost|Research Outpost]]. The rancor, rendered as docile as a [[bolma]] caf due to an implanted [[Brain/Legends|mind]]-control chip, was ultimately saved, and brought back to Loowobbli. Loowobbli also tasked the spacer with eliminating a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] who was banished from her clan. Out of anger, the Nightsister agreed to work with the Empire by aiding Nisshil in leading rancor hunting parties. Once again, the spacer succeeded.<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Wallaw Loowobbli was a non-player character in the video game ''Star Wars Galaxies'', a [[Star Wars video games#Game genres|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
